contract: contract.md: cinematic mobile book/menu tours and a native-scroll looping portfolio ribbon; real assets, filters, pause, touch, keyboard and lightbox.

accessibility.evidence: Chapter buttons retain labels and visible focus; all seven book/menu chapters reachable on 375x667. Carousel next/previous, explicit pause and lightbox Escape/focus-return exercised. Native touch emulation swiped 215px and opened/closed lightbox. Reduced-motion preference updated live, disabled autoplay and kept scroll position stable; no runtime errors in isolated mobile context. Existing contrast palette and focus rings visually reviewed.

responsive.evidence: Reviewed 390x844 Russian phone and 1440x900 German desktop screenshots. At 375x667 all book/menu chapter CTA bottoms measured 655px with no horizontal overflow. Cinematic transformations run in portrait mobile; very short landscape viewports and reduced motion keep a readable static composition. Physical Safari hardware was unavailable.

loading.evidence: Delayed mobile menu MP4 request reached data-playback-state=loading before simulated error.

empty.reason: Only nonempty categories are offered in the portfolio. A defensive empty message exists, but no public empty filter is reachable.

error.evidence: Aborted mobile menu video request displayed readable alert and retry inside the phone; screenshot menu-error.png.

partial.evidence: Failed video retained poster, chapter navigation and inquiry CTA. Unblocking the request recovered playback on retry.

success.evidence: Both tour videos advanced playback and paused. Carousel auto-loop crossed the repeated-cycle seam, pause held position, next moved one card, category filter reduced the collection to one item, lightbox restored canonical opener focus. Native touch swipe and tap succeeded.

permission.reason: Local curated media and explicit muted playback; no permission requests or submissions.
